messages.subject: gm.prcomp issue
parts:
Hi 

I tried a quick search and did not see this issue addressed before. I am using the newer gm.prcomp function but sometimes find that it does not output the 'shapes' value. It worked fine on a different dataset a few days ago, but now it is not. There is no error message. 

This is a screenshot of the values generated by the function:



I installed the most current versions of Geomorph and RRPP from Github.

Has anyone else had this issue or has any ideas why this would happen?

Thanks in advance.
Karen
